name: trackbee-claude-plugin
description: TrackBee Insights dashboards as a Claude plugin. Ships two Live Artifact reports — an Ad Performance dashboard covering Meta and Google campaign-level metrics with Scale/Hold/Refresh/Pause recommendations and a sortable per-campaign table, and an Attribution dashboard covering blended KPIs, NC-ROAS trend, channel attribution, customer-journey Sankey, and a daily heatmap. Both render as self-contained HTML.
